about_the_game:
Corrupted Souls is a dark action RPG that plunges you into a dying world consumed by betrayal, vengeance, and ancient horrors.

You are a silent warrior, cast into the abyss by the very kingdom you swore to protect. Now, surrounded by twisted monsters and cursed landscapes, your only way forward is through the blade.

Features:

Brutal Combat – Master dodges, parries, and strikes in skill-based battles.

The 'Burn' System – Embrace the demonic flame as you absorb damage and unleash your true form.

Deep Customization – Develop your stats and enhance your armor’s spirit to unlock unique resistances and abilities.

Lore-Rich Exploration – Discover the truth of your exile through ancient tombstones and lost relics.

Four Catastrophes – Conquer the elemental monsters chosen by the elders: Forest, Frost, Fire, and Lightning.

Steam Achievements & Cloud Save Support – Track your progress and play across devices.

Will you rise from the ashes, or be devoured by the world that betrayed you?

This app has unpublished changes. Changes can be viewed in the store beta mode . Valve must review and approve your store page before making it public for the first time as part of your release. Please see Preparing for Release for more details.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of violence and gore, including blood, death animations, and dark themes. Players may encounter disturbing visuals such as corpses, screams, and grotesque enemy designs. Viewer discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: High settings may require modern GPU. Game supports scalable quality options.

short_description: A brutal souls-like journey through a forgotten realm. Face merciless monsters, uncover buried truths, and reclaim what humanity has lost—your soul.
